prompt.alinti: You can now get Opus Clip without paying for it with this one open-source Github repo. It's called Supo Clip and it takes one long video and cuts it into ready post shorts for you so you don't edit everything by hand.
But it doesn't just edit randomly, it actually asks four questions about every single clip.
For example, does the opening hook you? Will people keep watching? Is it actually useful? And would somebody send it to a friend?
So out of a one hour long video, you only get back the clips most likely to go viral.
But the best part is that since it's open source, you run it completely yourself instead of paying every month for the link and setup comment clips.
Comment ‘CLIPS’ and I’ll DM you the link and the setup guide

yontem.ne: Open-source OpusClip alternatifi, uzun videoları viral olma potansiyeli yüksek kısa kliplere ayırır.
yontem.alinti: It scores every clip. An AI reads the transcript, picks the 3-7 best moments and scores each one on hook, engagement, value and shareability.

yontem.ne: Kliplerin viral olma olasılığını 4 kriter (hook, engagement, value, shareability) üzerinden puanlar.
Klipleri 9:16 oranına kırpar ve konuşmacının yüzünü ekranda merkezler.
yontem.alinti: Every clip is cropped to 9:16, face tracking keeps the speaker centred
subtitles are synced word by word

yontem.ne: TikTok/Reels/Shorts için hazır export preseti sunar.
yontem.alinti: Export presets for TikTok, Reels and Shorts

yontem.ne: GitHub üzerinden AGPL-3.0 lisansıyla açık kaynaklıdır; Docker ile kendi bilgisayarınızda çalıştırılabilir.
yontem.alinti: It’s open source (AGPL-3.0, 1.2k stars on GitHub): self-host it with Docker, unlimited on your own computer
